title: Last item
prompt: Return the last item of the array. The array always has at least one item.
starter:
func solve(items: Array) -> int:
	return items[0]
hint: The last position is one less than the size. Godot also lets you count from the end with a negative position.
solution:
func solve(items: Array) -> int:
	return items[items.size() - 1]
